causes.label: demand
causes.quote: The temperature in Adelaide on the day reached a maximum of 37 degrees, driving high demand. Demand was above 2500 MW between 2 pm and 4 pm, reaching a maximum of 2631 MW at 4 pm. At the time of high prices demand was greater than forecast four and 12 hours ahead.

causes.label: rebids
causes.quote: Rebidding at around 11.30 am by AGL shifted 340 MW of available capacity from prices below $101/MWh to the price cap. Dispatch of this AGL capacity set the price for the majority of the time between 1.35 pm and 4 pm.

causes.label: interconnector_limit
causes.quote: flows across the Heywood interconnector into South Australia were as forecast at its limit of 360 MW. Imports into South Australia across Murraylink were around 80 MW lower than that forecast and limited to around 100 MW.
